description: The custom visual 3D Bar Graph custom visual for Power BI provides an enhanced way to visualize categorical data using three-dimensional bars. By adding depth and perspective, it enables users to compare values across multiple categories and groups more effectively. This visual is ideal for performance comparison, trend analysis, and executive dashboards where visual impact and clarity are essential. Users can customize the X-axis, Y-axis to gain better insights and improve readability. Key features 3D Chart setting-: 3D Chart settings control the appearance and behavior of the chart. Manage the visual’s 3D appearance by switching between 2D and 3D modes. Adjust the rotation angle from 0° to 360° to view the chart from different perspectives. X-axis setting-:The X-axis represents the primary categories in the visual. Users can customize font size, font family, and font color to improve readability and align with report themes. Y-axis setting-: The Y-axis displays the numerical values. Users can personalize axis formatting, including Display Units, Decimal Places, font styling, and scale settings for accurate value representation. Legend setting-: The legend is essential for understanding the different data series in a chart,with this feature, users can modify the text appearance.
